headline: Committee discusses three Kahuluʻi land bills, takes no action on Bill 165 zoning change

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.summary: Testifiers spoke in support and raised concerns about the airport flight path and water from an old agricultural well. The bills go to the full council, which will say whether five or six votes are needed to pass them.
meeting.recap: The committee took up one item: Bills 163, 164 and 165 for a proposed project on land in Kahului.[[0:08:30]] Bill 163 would add the land to the Maui Island Plan's urban growth boundary.[[0:09:37]] Bill 164 would change the land's community plan designation from agriculture to business multifamily.[[0:10:55]] A hotel industry group's executive director testified in support, saying housing is the biggest hurdle for workforce development.[[0:54:56]] Another testifier said the project would put families directly beneath the Kahului Airport main flight path.[[1:06:14]] The area's committee member said he would probably ask to wait for the final EIS.[[2:02:26]] The full council will say whether five or six votes are needed to pass the bills.[[2:39:21]]
meeting.next: The housing director will be in contact with the project representative. No action was taken on Bill 165, the zoning change. A public hearing would also have to be scheduled for Bill 163.

moments.q: Chair: no conditions allowed on these plan amendments

trackerIssues.title: Bills 163 and 164 for 163-acre Central Maui growth

boards.name: Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

issues.oneLine: The proposed project plans to use private water instead of county water.
issues.brief: The project representative said the goal is to build the water system in partnership with the county and dedicate it to the county.[[#1]] A testifier raised concerns about water drawn from an old agricultural well.[[#2]]
